units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|You are passing through the spaceport when you see a young woman walking in your direction. Trailing behind her is a multitude of camera drones, each one marked with a logo consisting of two curves pointing inwards.|511|0

units.raw: `You are passing through the spaceport when you see a young woman walking in your direction. Trailing behind her is a multitude of camera drones, each one marked with a logo consisting of two curves pointing inwards.`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Wait for her to approach.)|513|0
units.english: (Wait for her to approach.)
units.raw: `	(Wait for her to approach.)`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Hope she doesn't notice me.)|515|0
units.english: (Hope she doesn't notice me.)
units.raw: `	(Hope she doesn't notice me.)`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	(Try to avoid her.)|517|0

units.raw: `	(Try to avoid her.)`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	You take a hallway off to the side to evade her. Just as you think you've gotten out of sight, you hear a voice. "Excuse me!" You turn to see the reporter following you.|518|0

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	As she gets closer to you, she smiles. "Hello Captain! Would you be willing to answer a few questions for our viewers?"|523|0
units.english: As she gets closer to you, she smiles. "Hello Captain! Would you be willing to answer a few questions for our viewers?"
units.raw: `	As she gets closer to you, she smiles. "Hello Captain! Would you be willing to answer a few questions for our viewers?"`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Sure, I wouldn't mind."|525|0
units.english: "Sure, I wouldn't mind."
units.raw: `	"Sure, I wouldn't mind."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"No, I'd rather not."|527|0
units.english: "No, I'd rather not."
units.raw: `	"No, I'd rather not."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The camera drones circle around you as she prepares for the interview. After a few seconds, she smiles at one of the drones and begins.|530|0

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Welcome back. I'm here on <origin> reporting on the situation with the Free Worlds. I'm joined by a merchant captain currently between trips. Captain, what do you think of the ultimatum sent to Parliament?"|531|0
units.english: "Welcome back. I'm here on <origin> reporting on the situation with the Free Worlds. I'm joined by a merchant captain currently between trips. Captain, what do you think of the ultimatum sent to Parliament?"
units.raw: `	"Welcome back. I'm here on <origin> reporting on the situation with the Free Worlds. I'm joined by a merchant captain currently between trips. Captain, what do you think of the ultimatum sent to Parliament?"`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I think Parliament should reconsider and give the situation some thought."|533|0
units.english: "I think Parliament should reconsider and give the situation some thought."
units.raw: `	"I think Parliament should reconsider and give the situation some thought."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"Parliament made the right decision by refusing the demands."|534|0
units.english: "Parliament made the right decision by refusing the demands."
units.raw: `	"Parliament made the right decision by refusing the demands."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	The reporter frowns. "Can you explain your answer for our viewers?"|536|0
units.english: The reporter frowns. "Can you explain your answer for our viewers?"
units.raw: `	The reporter frowns. "Can you explain your answer for our viewers?"`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The interests of every world should be considered, whether we agree or not."|538|0
units.english: "The interests of every world should be considered, whether we agree or not."
units.raw: `	"The interests of every world should be considered, whether we agree or not."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The Free Worlds aren't represented well enough to gain traction through normal channels."|539|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds aren't represented well enough to gain traction through normal channels."
units.raw: `	"The Free Worlds aren't represented well enough to gain traction through normal channels."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"The Navy is hardly defending that territory, so taxes shouldn't be as much."|540|0
units.english: "The Navy is hardly defending that territory, so taxes shouldn't be as much."
units.raw: `	"The Navy is hardly defending that territory, so taxes shouldn't be as much."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I would prefer to not answer."|541|0
units.english: "I would prefer to not answer."
units.raw: `	"I would prefer to not answer."`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"I'm not sure that Parliament would agree with you, but I want to thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.|542|0

units.raw: `	"I'm not sure that Parliament would agree with you, but I want to thank you for your answers, and for taking the time to do this interview!" she says.`

units.id: mission:News Reporter - Paradise|	"There are proper channels for presenting grievances, and this isn't one of them."|548|0
